FungicidesSuspension Concentrate (SC)

HAITOR

Hexaconazole 5% SC

"Broad-Spectrum Systemic Triazole Fungicide"

HAITOR is a broad-spectrum systemic fungicide belonging to the triazole family. It delivers comprehensive curative and preventive control of destructive fungal diseases like Sheath Blight in paddy, Powdery Mildew in vegetables, and Tikka leaf spot in oilseeds.

Product Type:Systemic Triazole Broad-Spectrum Fungicide
Available Packaging:100 ml, 250 ml, 500 ml, 1 Litre, 5 Litres
Inquire for Commercial SupplyBecome a Dealer

Mode of Action & Formulation Chemistry

Sterol Biosynthesis Inhibitor (Demethylation Inhibitor - DMI, FRAC Group 3). Inhibits ergosterol biosynthesis in fungal cell membranes, stopping germ tube elongation, haustoria formation, and mycelial growth.

Key Agronomic Benefits

  • Triple action performance: provides protective, curative, and antisporulant eradication.
  • Rapid systemic penetration within crop tissues ensuring rainfastness within 2 hours.
  • Imparts a distinct phytotonic greening effect, improving leaf photosynthesis and crop health.
  • Formulated as high-stability Suspension Concentrate (SC) with excellent suspension properties.
  • Compatible with most standard crop protection products for tank mixing.

Recommended Crops

Rice / PaddyChilli & VegetablesWheatSoybean & Pulses

Target Pests & Spectrum

  • Sheath Blight (Rhizoctonia solani) in Paddy
  • Powdery Mildew (Erysiphe / Leveillula spp.)
  • Tikka Disease & Early Leaf Spot (Cercospora arachidicola)
  • Rusts (Puccinia spp.)
  • Dieback & Fruit Rot in Chilli (Colletotrichum capsici)

Technical & Regulatory Specifications

Product Trade NameHAITOR
Active CompositionHexaconazole 5% SC
Formulation TypeSuspension Concentrate (SC)
Chemical GroupTriazole
Toxicity ClassificationClass III (Slightly Hazardous / Blue Triangle)
Shelf Life2 Years from manufacturing date.
Available Pack Sizes100 ml, 250 ml, 500 ml, 1 Litre, 5 Litres

Application Guidelines & Safety Stewardship

Method of Application:Foliar Spray at onset of initial disease symptoms or preventive weather triggers
Recommended Water Volume:150 - 200 Litres per acre
Waiting Period / Pre-Harvest Interval (PHI): Rice: 30 days, Groundnut: 30 days, Chilli: 7-10 days
Precautionary Measures:
  • Spray thoroughly covering both upper and lower canopy leaves.
  • Repeat application at 12-15 day intervals if high disease pressure persists.
